title: Aaja Asghar Mein Tera Jhoola Jhulawan Veeraa
body:
Dhoondti Phirti Teri Bhen Sakina Ujri,
Aaja Khaimay Meh Teri Pyaas Bhujawan Veeraa
<<DIVIDER>>
Raat Pur Khauf Hai Kaleya Tu Na Darda Howay
Yaad Ambri Nu Kade Babay Nu Karda Howay
Tu Eh Nazuk Te Bohot Garam Hawavaan Veeraa
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhen Sughra Ne Tere Pehjay Ne Si Ke Cholay
Oh Nayo Jaandi Tu Sogayo Mittiyan Olay
Keevain Ujri Nu Tera Haal Sunawan Veeraa
<<DIVIDER>>
Naa Tera Leh Ke Meri Ambri Eh Hokay Bhardi
Vekh Ke Jhoola Tera Veer Ve Jaway Mardi
Baaj Putraan De Kadoun Jeundiyan Mawaan Veeraa
<<DIVIDER>>
Hukam Babay Ne Vi Ghazi Nu Ditta Na Jang Da
Kadoun Marna Si Ehnay Tu Je Na Paani Mangda
Vaariyan Tere Uton Chachay Ne Bhawaan Veeraa
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaad Ambri Nu Jadoun Teri Sataway Asghar
Roway Tak Jhoola Tera Thandiyan Hawawaan Bhar Bhar
Hown Putraan Ton Juda Shala Na Mawaan Veeraa
<<DIVIDER>>
Vakhri Qaid Jadoun Veer Menu Howay Gi
Yaad Kar Kar Ke Teri Bhen Bara Roway Gi
Mein Tere Baaj Keevain Shaam Nu Jawaan Veeraa
